done.title: Thank you!
done.took: Saved. This helps us see where help is needed most.

city.label: City
legend.title: Legend
legend.faded: Pale dot: not confirmed for over 24 h
legend.small: Small dot: toilet, pharmacy or shop without a confirmed box
urgent.none_title: No confirmed point nearby right now

urgent.farther: The nearest confirmed point is further away:
urgent.night: At night we show places open 24/7 first.
urgent.no_geo: Move the map to where you are and search from the map centre.
dash.title: Kropka for Kraków
dash.subtitle: Anonymised data from the last {days} days. For the city, schools and NGOs.
kpi.active_hint: with a mark in this period
kpi.fresh_hint: of points confirmed in the last 24 h
ws.title: White spots: points are missing here
ws.story: {n} of {total} urgent searches found no point within a 10-minute walk. These are the places for new boxes.

demand.title: Demand
demand.story: Where hygiene products are taken most often.
demand.legend: Bigger circle = more takes in this period.
table.title: Fastest-emptying points
table.story: These boxes need refilling most often. A bigger box or a second one nearby would help.
dash.demo_footer: Demo data for the HackYeah presentation. Only the city toilet locations are real (Kraków open data).

add.title: Add a point
add.intro: Know a place with free hygiene products, or want to start one? Tell us. After a review it becomes a full point on the map.
add.map_hint: Drag the dot or tap the map where the point is.
add.no_location: Could not get your location. Drag the dot on the map instead.
add.name: Name of the place
add.name_required: Please enter the name of the place (at least 3 characters).
add.privacy: No photos and no personal data.
add.done: Point {id} has been suggested and is waiting for review. It is already visible on the map.
error.duplicate: There is already a point here.
error.outside_city: This place is outside the city.
error.bad_hours: The opening time must be before the closing time.
error.add_limit: Thank you! You can add more points tomorrow.
steward.title: My points
steward.intro: The points you look after. When one runs empty you will see an alert here and can confirm the refill with one tap.
steward.empty: You don't look after any point yet. Open a point on the map and choose "Look after this point".
steward.privacy: No account: this list is stored only in this browser. In this demo the alert appears while this page is open.
partner.thanks: Thank you for making this place part of Kropka. Every take is someone you helped.
partner.tip_fast: This box runs empty in under 2 days. A bigger stock or more frequent refills would help a lot.
